policy: Bring-up starts with energy limiting and independent observation. Current/voltage limits must be reviewed against the assembled board before energization and are not guessed by this plan.

sequence.action: apply current-limited 12 V field input with carrier/DUT disconnected
sequence.advance_if: rail voltages/current remain inside reviewed limits

sequence.action: power carrier interface with local field power states exercised
exercise watchdog/interlock and AO disconnect without real DUT
sequence.advance_if: hardware inhibit paths operate as designed

sequence.action: connect passive/dummy low-energy loads and exercise ADC/DAC/interface paths
only then connect reviewed real DUT adapter
sequence.advance_if: DUT adapter acceptance plan limits are bound
